name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
description: You have learned the basics of the Cleric spellcasting tradition. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells.
shortDescription: Learn two Cleric cantrips and one level 1 Cleric spell.

benefits.name: Two Cantrips
benefits.description: Choose two cantrips from the Cleric spell list. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells.

benefits.name: Level 1 Spell
benefits.description: Choose one level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

benefits.name: Changing Spells
benefits.description: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the Cleric spell list.

choices.prompt: Choose two cantrips from the Cleric spell list.
Choose one level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list.
